company.shortDescription: MyVR, a Guesty company, is a cloud-based, multi-channel management platform for vacation rental businesses.
company.description: MyVR, a Guesty company, is a cloud-based, multi-channel management platform that provides short-term rental businesses with the ability to simplify and centralize property management across key booking channels from a single dashboard. The software streamlines and automates day-to-day tasks in order to save businesses time and resources, reduce efforts and improve the experience of travelers.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $6,100,000, or 81.33% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $7,033,702 to $33,686,174, a 4.79x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
